verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a full API reference. That includes a rendered docs site, a plain-text /llms-api.txt reference and a parseable OpenAPI spec with 174 paths. It also offers a no-auth Developer MCP server for exploring the reference and a sandbox API base (demo-api.ramp.com) for safely running calls. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive with in-page runnable examples; running requests appears to require the sandbox, the CLI or importing the spec into other tools. Missing for 10: a documented in-browser try-it console or runnable code examples in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
